input.free_text_description: This system is a microservices platform that serves Candidate, User roles. The platform provides capabilities for config application, eureka application, file application. Secondary concerns include user management functionality.

user_stories.story: As a User, I want to securely sign in to the system, so that I can access my personalized resources.
As a Candidate, I want to search and filter records, so that I can quickly find relevant information.
As an Admin, I want to manage system configuration and monitor operations, so that I can ensure the platform runs smoothly.
As a Candidate, I want to upload and manage files, so that I can store and retrieve documents when needed.
As a Candidate, I want to interact with movie functionality, so that I can accomplish my movie-related tasks.
